notes: BLS QCEW Open Data API, NAICS 31-33 (total manufacturing), private ownership, Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue MSA -- matches the broad total-manufacturing convention already established for this metric in Chicago (via FRED) and DC (via QCEW), for cross-city consistency. A narrower, arguably more conceptually accurate alternative was also found and NOT used here: NAICS 3364 (Aerospace/Boeing) alone, fully clean 2015-2024 (e.g. 2015: 91,108), which better matches 'high-value, technology-intensive manufacturing' than a total-manufacturing figure that also includes food processing, wood products, etc. -- flagged for methodology-lead reconsideration rather than decided unilaterally.
Same source/methodology as 2015 (aerospace-only alternative: 77,836). 2025 not imported -- annual QCEW not yet published for either basis.
